create_dotsvlm_model: create a DotsVLMForCausalLM model instance with a config and optional quantization config
load_dotsvlm_weights: load vision and language model weights into a DotsVLMForCausalLM from a weight iterable
get_image_feature: get image embeddings from a list of MultimodalDataItem objects through the vision tower
pad_dotsvlm_input_ids: pad input_ids with multimodal tokens using a multimodal padding pattern
run_dotsvlm_forward: run a forward pass on a DotsVLMForCausalLM with input_ids, positions, and a forward batch
